## Goal
Check the three mail pages against the app's mailbox step and fix what is stale, in plain words. The step title is "A separate email address for replies" (`src/freemyid/wizard/draft.py:69`).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Gmail: the app-password steps match the app's own instructions (`src/freemyid/wizard/ui.py:214-219`) and the preset (`draft.py:74-75`); Proton: the Bridge preset (`draft.py:76`); other providers: what the person needs to ask their provider.
- Every screen label quoted from the app has a citation on the same line; any step about Google's or Proton's own screens that the repo can't confirm is marked "Google's page may look different" rather than guessed.
- Explains why a separate address is used, in the app's words, and that the password is kept on this computer as far as the source says (check before claiming).
- No real email addresses: use `jane.testperson@example.com`.
- Every existing link and anchor still resolves (`test_cp_doc_links.py`).

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.
